answer: Each identity binds a registered fable mark, a coined word in the Ocean Register. Filing costs 250 POA, examination lasts 60 days, yearly renewal needs proof of use. Examiners refuse near-duplicates, so each fake needs a new word. A 30 POA bond locks 90 days per mark; the next posts 60, then 120, doubling to 960, so 100 fakes lock 92,130 POA in bonds plus 25,000 POA fees, against 280 POA for one trader. Dawn audits each epoch re-check each mark in 72 hours; two failures halve the bond and suspend rewards 3 epochs. A firm with many marks passes when each shows 10,000 POA of yearly sales.
